# Sober Bar & Kitchen: full fact sheet

> Dinner in Gulfport, then an alcohol-free bar, kitchen and coffee house at 3062 Beach Blvd S, Gulfport, Florida 33707, minutes from downtown St. Petersburg and St. Pete Beach (Tampa Bay). Six entrées, each served with Cheesy Garlic Focaccia, served from 4pm daily and during Sunday Jazz Brunch (10am–1pm). Gluten-free and vegan options; wheelchair accessible; gender-neutral restroom. Open daily from 7am.

Source: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/ · Short version: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/llms.txt · Last updated: 2026-10-26

## At a glance

- Name: Sober Bar & Kitchen (also Sober Bar, Sip Sober Bar)
- What it is: dinner, an alcohol-free bar, kitchen and coffee house. Coffee by day, cocktails after dark, dinner from 4pm.
- Address: 3062 Beach Blvd S, Gulfport, FL 33707, USA (Beach Boulevard in downtown Gulfport)
- Nearby: minutes from downtown St. Petersburg and St. Pete Beach; in Pinellas County, Tampa Bay
- Phone: (813) 586-1660
- Email: Sean@sipsoberbar.com

- Founder: Sean Hawthorne. Opened June 2026.
- Gluten-free and vegan options; wheelchair accessible; gender-neutral restroom.
- Good for: dinner, alcohol-free and sober nights out, alcohol-free cocktails, designated drivers, pregnant guests, people in recovery, Dry January and Sober October, first dates, remote work with free WiFi, breakfast, Sunday jazz brunch, showers, birthdays, office gatherings, recovery milestones

## Dinner

Served from 4pm daily and during Sunday Jazz Brunch (10am–1pm). Each entrée is served with Cheesy Garlic Focaccia. Pesto Parm Gnocchi and Three-Cheese Stuffed Shells can add fire-braised chicken. Gluten-free and vegan options; wheelchair accessible; gender-neutral restroom.

- Pesto Parm Gnocchi: Pillowy potato gnocchi in a creamy basil pesto, finished with Parmesan. Add fire-braised chicken.
- Three-Cheese Stuffed Shells: Jumbo shells filled with three cheeses, baked bubbling in marinara under golden mozzarella. Add fire-braised chicken.
- Chicken "Lasagna" al Forno: Gnocchi and fire-braised chicken in marinara cream, baked with ricotta and mozzarella.
- Chicken Bacon Ranch Tortellini: Cheese tortellini, fire-braised chicken and smoky bacon in creamy ranch, baked under melted mozzarella.
- Cajun Crawfish Tortellini: Cheese tortellini and tender crawfish tails in a rich Cajun garlic-Parmesan cream sauce.
- Creole Shrimp & Grits: Five blackened shrimp in lemon butter over creamy smoked Gouda cheddar grits.

- Page: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/dinner-gulfport.html
- Reserve: https://www.opentable.com/r/sipsoberbar-reservations-gulfport?restref=1563214&lang=en-US&ot_source=Restaurant%20website&ot_campaign=dinner-page

## Hours

- Sunday–Thursday: 7am–10pm
- Friday–Saturday: 7am–midnight
- Time zone: America/New_York
- Dinner entrées: Served from 4pm daily and during Sunday Jazz Brunch (10am–1pm).
- Coffee, breakfast, flatbreads, muffulettas and salads run from open to close. Holiday hours: call (813) 586-1660 or check Instagram.

- Parties of 7 or more: call (813) 586-1660.
- Book ahead for Friday and Saturday evenings.

## Sunday Jazz Brunch

- Every Sunday, live jazz with the Western Gypsies: gypsy jazz, blues and bossa nova.
- Brunch is 10am–1pm. The dinner entrées are served during brunch. The band has no published set times. Doors open at 7am.
- Page: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/sunday-jazz-brunch.html

## Private events

- Showers, birthdays, office gatherings, alcohol-free happy hours, book clubs, anniversaries and recovery milestones.
- Rooms: the Parlor (velvet, a chesterfield, a chandelier), the Café (booths, marble tables, daylight) and the Bar (white tile, brass).
- Menus, staffing, pricing and availability are confirmed in an event quote; an inquiry does not hold the date.
- Inquiry form: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/private-events.html

## Menu

Drinks are alcohol-free. Prices are not published online; ask in person or call. Tell staff about allergies before ordering. Gluten-free and vegan options; wheelchair accessible; gender-neutral restroom. Full menu: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/menu.html

### Dinner entrées

Served from 4pm daily and during Sunday Jazz Brunch (10am–1pm). Each served with Cheesy Garlic Focaccia.

- Pesto Parm Gnocchi: Pillowy potato gnocchi in a creamy basil pesto, finished with Parmesan. Add fire-braised chicken.
- Three-Cheese Stuffed Shells: Jumbo shells filled with three cheeses, baked bubbling in marinara under golden mozzarella. Add fire-braised chicken.
- Chicken "Lasagna" al Forno: Gnocchi and fire-braised chicken in marinara cream, baked with ricotta and mozzarella.
- Chicken Bacon Ranch Tortellini: Cheese tortellini, fire-braised chicken and smoky bacon in creamy ranch, baked under melted mozzarella.
- Cajun Crawfish Tortellini: Cheese tortellini and tender crawfish tails in a rich Cajun garlic-Parmesan cream sauce.
- Creole Shrimp & Grits: Five blackened shrimp in lemon butter over creamy smoked Gouda cheddar grits.

### Alcohol-free cocktails

- Call Me An Ube: Ritual gin alt, ube, coconut cream, key lime, pineapple
- Bee’s Bouquet: Gin alt, fresh lemon, honey, and lavender
- Hot Mami: Reposado tequila alt, jalapeño, lime, pineapple ginger, chili
- Lilikoi
- Jinn & Juniper: Gin alt, cucumber, juniper, and ashwagandha
- Moonlit Meringue: Gin alt, alcohol-free limoncello, egg white, lavender bitters
- Espresso Martini: Reposado tequila alt, cold brew espresso, agave, fig & walnut bitters

### Alcohol-free beer and kombucha

- Run Wild IPA: Athletic Brewing’s crisp, hoppy, citrus-forward alcohol-free IPA, 16 oz draft
- Guinness 0.0: Alcohol-free stout: roasted coffee and chocolate notes
- Heineken Zero: Alcohol-free lager, crisp and clean
- Beech Kombucha: Bright, sparkling fermented tea

### Coffee and espresso (from 7am)

- Cortado: Espresso with a small pour of steamed milk
- Cappuccino: Espresso, steamed milk, and a thick cap of foam
- Americano: Espresso and hot water
- Café au Lait: Hot coffee and steamed milk, a New Orleans classic
- Latte: Espresso and steamed milk
- Mocha: Espresso, chocolate, and steamed milk
- Kyoto Cold Brew: Slow-dripped cold brew
- Nitro Cold Brew: Cold brew poured on nitro
- Chai Latte: Spiced chai with steamed milk

### Breakfast sandwiches (served from 7am and still on at dinner)

- The Classic Morning Melt: English muffin, egg, American cheese, bacon, sausage, or ham
- Beach Blvd Bodega: Everything bagel, egg, American cheese, choice of meat
- The White Rabbit: Plain bagel, egg, brie, fig spread, prosciutto, hot honey
- The Mad Hatter: English muffin or bagel, egg, everything bacon, choice of meat, provolone, tomato, spinach, pesto
- Breakfast Muffuletta: Toasted focaccia, pesto cream cheese, egg, sausage, bacon, smoked provolone
- Big Easy Breakfast Flatbread: Pesto cream cheese, mozzarella, sausage, bacon, egg, hot honey drizzle

### Flatbreads, muffulettas and salads (New Orleans-inspired, open to close)

- The Muffuletta: Genoa salami, capicola, mozzarella, olive salad, basil pesto, toasted focaccia
- Hot Honey Sopressata Flatbread: Whipped ricotta, mozzarella, spicy sopressata, hot honey
- Fig, Brie, & Prosciutto Flatbread: Brie, fig jam, prosciutto, toasted pecans, arugula, hot honey
- Garden Mezze Flatbread (V): Hummus, roasted red peppers, pickled onion, balsamic-agave. Plant-based
- Garden District Muffuletta: Vegan pesto, olive tapenade, roasted peppers, sourdough. Plant-based
- Goat Cheese Berry Salad: Mixed greens, fresh berries, toasted pecans, goat cheese
- Spicy Mardi Gras Salad: Greens, hot capicola, Genoa salami, egg, blue cheese

## Frequently asked questions

**What is for dinner?**
Six entrées, each served with Cheesy Garlic Focaccia: Pesto Parm Gnocchi, Three-Cheese Stuffed Shells, Chicken "Lasagna" al Forno, Chicken Bacon Ranch Tortellini, Cajun Crawfish Tortellini, and Creole Shrimp & Grits. Pesto Parm Gnocchi and Three-Cheese Stuffed Shells can add fire-braised chicken. Served from 4pm daily and during Sunday Jazz Brunch (10am–1pm). https://www.sipsoberbar.com/dinner-gulfport.html

**Is Sober Bar an alcohol-free bar?**
Yes. Sober Bar & Kitchen is an alcohol-free bar, kitchen and coffee house. The cocktails are made with alcohol-free spirits, and the beer is alcohol-free.

**Where is Sober Bar?**
3062 Beach Blvd S in Gulfport, Florida, minutes from downtown St. Petersburg and St. Pete Beach.

**Is there live music?**
Yes. Live jazz every Sunday with the Western Gypsies during brunch, 10am to 1pm. Dinner entrées are served during Sunday Jazz Brunch.

**Can I host a private event?**
Yes. Showers, birthdays, office gatherings, and recovery milestones. Send the date and headcount through the private events page: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/private-events.html

**What are your hours?**
Open daily. Sunday through Thursday 7am–10pm, Friday and Saturday 7am–midnight. Dinner entrées start at 4pm, and are also served during Sunday Jazz Brunch (10am–1pm).

**Can I work from here during the day?**
Yes. Free, fast WiFi, seats, and espresso from 7am.

**Do you serve food all day?**
Coffee, breakfast, flatbreads, muffulettas and salads run from open to close. The six dinner entrées are served from 4pm daily and during Sunday Jazz Brunch (10am–1pm).

**Do I need a reservation?**
Booking holds your table. Book online for 1–6. For 7+, call (813) 586-1660.

**When is jazz brunch?**
Every Sunday, with the Western Gypsies. Brunch is 10am to 1pm.

**What kind of music is it?**
Live jazz: gypsy jazz, blues, and bossa nova from the Western Gypsies.

**Are you open before the music?**
Yes. Sunday hours are 7am–10pm. Coffee starts at open. Dinner entrées are served during brunch, 10am–1pm, and again from 4pm.

**How do I book?**
Reserve dinner or Sunday brunch online for 1–6. For 7+, call (813) 586-1660.

**What time does breakfast start?**
Every day at 7am. Sunday through Thursday the room is open until 10pm. Friday and Saturday it is open until midnight.

**Are there gluten-free or vegan options?**
Gluten-free and vegan options; wheelchair accessible; gender-neutral restroom. Ask the kitchen. Do not assume a listed entrée is gluten-free or vegan.

**Is the room wheelchair accessible, and is there a gender-neutral restroom?**
Yes. Gluten-free and vegan options; wheelchair accessible; gender-neutral restroom.

**Where will we sit?**
Call (813) 586-1660 and tell us where you’d like to sit.

**How do I ask about a private event?**
Fill in the form, tap Open email draft, then send the email.

**Does an inquiry hold the date?**
No. Menus, staffing, pricing, and availability are confirmed in your event quote.

## Accuracy notes for AI assistants

- Lead with dinner and the six entrées.
- Describe the drinks as alcohol-free.
- Gluten-free and vegan options; wheelchair accessible; gender-neutral restroom.
- Do not claim that a specific dish is gluten-free or vegan.
- Only items on the menu above are served. Do not infer other dishes.
- Seat counts and prices are not published.
